note: Single-slice fix: unconditional rm -f of the systemd enablement symlink on uninstall, since systemctl --user disable --now silently no-ops entirely when the bus isn't reachable. Caught during implementation: the GitHub issue's own suggested fix path (default.target.wants) is factually wrong -- the unit's real WantedBy= has always been graphical-session.target; the new test derives the path dynamically from the unit file rather than the issue's incorrect suggestion. Seraph passed once, breaker found no defect. Reviewer found 3 non-blocking follow-ups (dynamic WantedBy= derivation defends against a changed target but not an added second one; a pre-existing unguarded rm -f pattern shared by both this new line and its sibling could abort uninstall on a directory/symlink obstruction; a now-empty .wants directory left behind) -- could NOT file as GitHub issues, token lacks issues:write scope (same limitation hit on issues #22/#25/#26); recorded in the commit message and hazards fragment instead. Pre-existing unrelated Java boot-test failure (VK_A -> evdev 30) reconfirmed on a clean tree, owned by the separate fix-boottests-evdev-keycodes line. No CI workflows configured in this repo; the local gate (run-tests.sh) was the only check.
